description: This file implements an LRU-based seen event tracker with TTL support, including interfaces, functions for managing entries, eviction, pruning, and lifecycle control.

classes.name: SeenTracker
classes.description: Interface defining the methods for a seen event tracker with TTL and LRU eviction.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Internal interface representing a tracked event with timestamp and linked list pointers.

methods.name: createSeenTracker
methods.description: Factory function creating a new seen tracker with configurable options for max entries, TTL, and prune interval.
